title: Git: push to a branch outside the working set
support_note: A push no grant or working-set entry covers whole files one request for the whole push: internal/gitbroker/approval.go askForPush, which builds the About with pushAbout and the request with pushRequest (approvalauthority.go).
story: An agent pushes a fix to an existing branch of example-org/app that its working set does not cover, in the same push as a branch that is covered; only the uncovered ref needs approval.
